ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens, bright green curly-edged lettuce leaves and darker green flat leaves with red-purple stems, spread across the right and center of the plate, covering roughly 35% of the plate surface, leaves about 5-10 cm long, moist with a matte finish and some wilting at edges, sitting directly on the white plate | 60

ITEM 2 | Dark reddish-brown, slightly glossy pieces with irregular edges and a soft, moist texture, clustered in the center and lower center of the plate beneath the greens, covering roughly 12% of the plate, pieces about 2-4 cm across and up to 1 cm thick, appearing to be lightly cooked or wilted with some pink-tinged areas | 45

ITEM 3 | Pale beige-pink chunk with a smooth, slightly shiny surface and soft edges, tucked among the greens near the upper center of the plate, covering roughly 3% of the plate, about 3 cm across and 1.5 cm thick, appearing moist and firm, partly under leaves | 12
